jobs.title: Data Management Specialist - Operations (m/w/d) 80 -100%
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Supervisor

__

Role and responsibilities

In this role, you will ensure the quality and availability of production data in SAP, the PLM system and the shop floor applications. As the central interface between production, engineering and IT, you will represent the requirements of manufacturing in digitization projects and contribute to the successful introduction and further development of our system landscape.

You are the voice of production in our digitalization projects.

Working model:

Predominantly on-site; hybrid working is possible depending on the area of responsibility.

Main • Responsibilities


  • Responsibility for the creation, maintenance and cleansing of SAP master data (material masters, parts lists, routings and work centers) including mass changes and analysis of process effects.

  • Representation of production in the introduction and further development of digital systems, in particular PTC Windchill and Tulip, including requirements definition, testing and training of key users.

  • Carrying out tests and verifications of SAP adaptations in close cooperation with the respective specialist and IT managers.

  • Analysis and preparation of production and process data as well as development of reports and dashboards with Power BI based on SAP, SQL, Excel and other data sources.

Your qualifications

  • Commercial or technical training with further training or studies in business informatics, production, logistics or similar
  • Several years of experience as an SAP Power User, ideally in PP/MM
  • In-depth understanding of BOMs, routings, and change processes
  • Experience in system implementation projects
  • Knowledge of PLM (e.g. Windchill), MES/low-code platforms (e.g. Tulip), SQL or Power BI are a clear advantage
  • Analytical, structured and quality-conscious way of working
  • Fluent in German and good knowledge of English.

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings is redesigning commercial, industrial and residential buildings through digitalization, providing greater comfort, efficiency, safety and protection. With safe, smart and sustainable electrification solutions, services and products, we are helping to improve the quality of life in the buildings of the future.

We look forward to receiving your application! The recruitment process is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a operare in modo più efficiente e pulito—e ogni persona qui contribuisce a renderlo possibile. Avrai l'opportunità di guidare, il supporto per crescere e l'orgoglio per l'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a far funzionare ciò che fa funzionare il mondo.

Questa posizione riporta a:
Supervisore della produzione

__

Ruolo e responsabilità

In questo ruolo, garantirai la qualità e la disponibilità dei dati di produzione in SAP, nel sistema PLM e nelle applicazioni di reparto. In qualità di interfaccia centrale tra produzione, ingegneria e IT, rappresenterai i requisiti della produzione nei progetti di digitalizzazione e contribuirai all'introduzione efficace e all'ulteriore sviluppo del nostro panorama applicativo.

Sei la voce della produzione nei nostri progetti di digitalizzazione.

Modello di lavoro:

Prevalentemente in presenza; il lavoro ibrido è possibile in base all'area di responsabilità.

Principali
• Responsabilità

- Responsabilità della creazione, manutenzione e pulizia dei dati anagrafici SAP (anagrafiche materiali, distinte base, cicli e centri di lavoro), comprese le modifiche di massa e l'analisi degli effetti sui processi.

- Rappresentanza della produzione nell'introduzione e nell'ulteriore sviluppo dei sistemi digitali, in particolare PTC Windchill e Tulip, inclusi la definizione dei requisiti, i test e la formazione degli utenti chiave.

- Esecuzione di test e verifiche degli adattamenti di SAP in stretta collaborazione con i rispettivi responsabili delle funzioni specialistiche e dell'IT.

- Analisi e preparazione dei dati di produzione e di processo, nonché sviluppo di report e dashboard con Power BI basati su SAP, SQL, Excel e altre fonti di dati.

Le tue qualifiche

- Formazione commerciale o tecnica, con ulteriore formazione o studi in informatica gestionale, produzione, logistica o ambiti simili

- Diversi anni di esperienza come SAP Power User, idealmente in PP/MM

- Conoscenza approfondita di distinte base, cicli e processi di modifica

- Esperienza in progetti di implementazione di sistemi

- La conoscenza di PLM (ad es. Windchill), piattaforme MES/low-code (ad es. Tulip), SQL o Power BI costituisce un chiaro vantaggio

- Approccio al lavoro analitico, strutturato e attento alla qualità

- Conoscenza fluente del tedesco e buona conoscenza dell'inglese.

Maggiori informazioni su di noi

ABB Smart Buildings sta riprogettando gli edifici commerciali, industriali e residenziali attraverso la digitalizzazione, offrendo maggiore comfort, efficienza, sicurezza e protezione. Con soluzioni, servizi e prodotti di elettrificazione sicuri, intelligenti e sostenibili, contribuiamo a migliorare la qualità della vita negli edifici del futuro.

Saremo lieti di ricevere la tua candidatura! Il processo di selezione è gestito da Reto Korstick, Talent Partner presso ABB Switzerland.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e più intelligente richiede menti di ogni tipo: curiose, coraggiose e creative. Ecco perché diamo il benvenuto a persone di ogni provenienza e con esperienze diverse.

Pronto a fare la differenza?

Candidati oggi stesso o visita https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien dabei, effizienter und umweltfreundlicher zu arbeiten – und jede Person hier trägt dazu bei. Sie werden befähigt, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, bei Ihrer Weiterentwicklung unterstützt und stolz auf die Wirkung sein, die wir gemeinsam erzielen. Kommen Sie zu uns und helfen Sie dabei, das zu betreiben, was die Welt am Laufen hält.

Diese Position berichtet an:
Produktionsleiter

__

Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

In dieser Rolle stellen Sie die Qualität und Verfügbarkeit von Produktionsdaten in SAP, dem PLM-System und den Shopfloor-Anwendungen sicher. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion, Engineering und IT vertreten Sie die Anforderungen der Fertigung in Digitalisierungsprojekten und tragen zur erfolgreichen Einführung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Systemlandschaft bei.

Sie sind die Stimme der Produktion in unseren Digitalisierungsprojekten.

Arbeitsmodell:

Überwiegend vor Ort; je nach Verantwortungsbereich ist hybrides Arbeiten möglich.

Wichtigste
• Verantwortlichkeiten

- Verantwortung für die Erstellung, Pflege und Bereinigung von SAP-Stammdaten (Materialstämme, Stücklisten, Arbeitspläne und Arbeitsplätze) einschließlich Massenänderungen und der Analyse von Prozessauswirkungen.

- Vertretung der Produktion bei der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Systeme, insbesondere PTC Windchill und Tulip, einschließlich Anforderungsdefinition, Tests und Schulung von Key-Usern.

- Durchführung von Tests und Verifizierungen von SAP-Anpassungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den jeweiligen Fach- und IT-Leitungen.

- Analyse und Aufbereitung von Produktions- und Prozessdaten sowie Entwicklung von Berichten und Dashboards mit Power BI auf Basis von SAP, SQL, Excel und anderen Datenquellen.

Ihre Qualifikationen

- Kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung oder Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Produktion, Logistik oder Ähnlichem

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung als SAP Power User, idealerweise in PP/MM

- Fundierte Kenntnisse von Stücklisten, Arbeitsplänen und Änderungsprozessen

- Erfahrung in Systemimplementierungsprojekten

- Kenntnisse in PLM (z. B. Windchill), MES-/Low-Code-Plattformen (z. B. Tulip), SQL oder Power BI sind von klarem Vorteil

- Analytische, strukturierte und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Mehr über uns

ABB Smart Buildings gestaltet gewerbliche, industrielle und Wohngebäude durch Digitalisierung neu und sorgt für mehr Komfort, Effizienz, Sicherheit und Schutz. Mit sicheren, intelligenten und nachhaltigen Lösungen, Dienstleistungen und Produkten für die Elektrifizierung tragen wir dazu bei, die Lebensqualität in den Gebäuden der Zukunft zu verbessern.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Der Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Reto Korstick, Talent Partner bei ABB Switzerland, geleitet.

Eine sauberere, intelligentere Zukunft zu gestalten, erfordert ganz unterschiedliche Köpfe: neugierige, mutige und kreative. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.

Sind Sie bereit, etwas zu bewirken?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Wirkung unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus efficacement et plus proprement — et chaque personne ici y contribue. Vous aurez les moyens de prendre les devants, le soutien nécessaire pour évoluer et la fierté de l’impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et contribuez à faire fonctionner ce qui fait tourner le monde.

Ce poste est rattaché à :
Superviseur de production

__

Rôle et responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous veillerez à la qualité et à la disponibilité des données de production dans SAP, le système PLM et les applications de l’atelier. En tant qu’interface centrale entre la production, l’ingénierie et l’informatique, vous représenterez les exigences de la production dans les projets de digitalisation et contribuerez au déploiement réussi et au développement continu de notre environnement système.

Vous êtes la voix de la production dans nos projets de digitalisation.

Mode de travail :

Principalement sur site ; le travail hybride est possible selon le domaine de responsabilité.

Principales
• Responsabilités

- Responsabilité de la création, de la maintenance et du nettoyage des données de base SAP (fiches articles, nomenclatures, gammes et postes de travail), y compris les modifications en masse et l’analyse des effets sur les processus.

- Représentation de la production lors de l’introduction et de l’évolution des systèmes numériques, en particulier PTC Windchill et Tulip, y compris la définition des exigences, les tests et la formation des utilisateurs clés.

- Réalisation de tests et de vérifications des adaptations SAP en étroite collaboration avec les responsables métier et informatiques concernés.

- Analyse et préparation des données de production et de processus ainsi que développement de rapports et de tableaux de bord avec Power BI à partir de SAP, SQL, Excel et d’autres sources de données.

Vos qualifications

- Formation commerciale ou technique, complétée par une formation continue ou des études en informatique de gestion, en production, en logistique ou dans un domaine similaire

- Plusieurs années d’expérience en tant que superutilisateur SAP, idéalement dans PP/MM

- Compréhension approfondie des nomenclatures, des gammes et des processus de modification

- Expérience dans des projets de mise en œuvre de systèmes

- La connaissance de PLM (p. ex. Windchill), des plateformes MES/low-code (p. ex. Tulip), de SQL ou de Power BI constitue un avantage certain

- Méthode de travail analytique, structurée et axée sur la qualité

- Maîtrise de l’allemand et bonnes connaissances de l’anglais.

En savoir plus sur nous

ABB Smart Buildings repense les bâtiments commerciaux, industriels et résidentiels grâce à la digitalisation, en offrant davantage de confort, d’efficacité, de sécurité et de protection. Grâce à des solutions, services et produits d’électrification sûrs, intelligents et durables, nous contribuons à améliorer la qualité de vie dans les bâtiments de demain.

Nous avons hâte de recevoir votre candidature ! Le processus de recrutement est piloté par Reto Korstick, partenaire chargé des talents chez ABB Switzerland.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent nécessite toutes sortes d’esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C’est pourquoi nous accueillons des personnes de tous horizons et aux expériences diverses.

Êtes-vous prêt à avoir un impact ?

Postulez dès aujourd’hui ou consultez https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l’impact de nos solutions dans le monde entier.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician (Region Central Switzerland) f/m/d (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Team Leader

__

In this position, you will perform service activities in accordance with work instructions and ABB quality and safety guidelines. You will ensure excellent customer service on a daily basis by planning service assignments and executing them in line with customer requirements and expectations. Through your clear and professional communication, you will contribute to customer satisfaction and loyalty by providing transparent information regarding schedules, processes, and expectations.


Work model: Field-based


This role is part of the Electrification, Smart Power division in Baden. Your key stakeholders will include customers, field service colleagues, and the internal service coordination team.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Collaborate with customers on-site to identify optimization opportunities and resolve existing challenges
  • Perform service assignments, identify technical issues, and conduct on-site or remote analysis within the service categories and product areas for which you are certified
  • Prepare material lists for service assignments and ensure that all required materials, spare parts, and tools are available, complete, and in proper working condition
  • Provide training to field service colleagues and customers as required

Our team


You will become part of a collaborative and supportive team where you can continue to grow both professionally and personally.



Your qualifications


  • Completed vocational training as an Automation Technician, Electrician, Electrical Installer, Electrical Planner, or a comparable technical qualification
  • At least 3 years of professional experience in automation, electrical engineering, or a related technical field; experience with UPS systems (uninterruptible power supply) is an advantage
  • Solid knowledge of electromechanical systems, diagnostic tools, and service processes in an industrial environment
  • Strong customer focus, flexibility in adapting to changing requirements, and a solution-oriented and collaborative approach to teamwork
  • Fluent German and basic English skills for professional communication with customers
  • Willingness to travel, participate in an on-call rotation, and occasionally work weekends; primary service area: Region Central Switzerland
  • Valid driver's license for assignments within Switzerland


In dieser Position führen Sie Servicearbeiten gemäss den Arbeitsanweisungen sowie den Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien von ABB durch. Sie stellen täglich einen ausgezeichneten Kundenservice sicher, indem Sie Serviceeinsätze planen und diese entsprechend den • Anforderungen und Erwartungen der Kunden ausführen. Durch Ihre klare und professionelle Kommunikation tragen Sie zur Kundenzufriedenheit und Kundenbindung bei, indem Sie transparente Informationen zu Zeitplänen, Abläufen und Erwartungen vermitteln.


Arbeitsmodell: Aussendienst


Diese Position ist Teil der Division Electrification, Smart Power in Baden. Zu Ihren wichtigsten Ansprechpartnern gehören Kunden, Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Field Service sowie das interne Service-Koordinationsteam.


Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden vor Ort, um Optimierungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und bestehende Herausforderungen zu lösen
  • Durchführung von Serviceeinsätzen, Identifizierung technischer Probleme sowie Durchführung von Analysen vor Ort oder aus der Ferne innerhalb der Servicekategorien und Produktbereiche, für die Sie zertifiziert sind
  • Erstellung von Materiallisten für Serviceeinsätze und Sicherstellung, dass alle erforderlichen Materialien, Ersatzteile und Werkzeuge vollständig verfügbar und in einwandfreiem Zustand sind
  • Durchführung von Schulungen für Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Field Service sowie für Kunden nach Bedarf


Unser Team
Sie werden Teil eines kollegialen und unterstützenden Teams, in dem Sie sich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterentwickeln können.

• Ihre Qualifikationen

  • Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Automatiker/in, Elektriker/in, Elektroinstallateur/in, Elektroplaner/in oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation
  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Automatisierung, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich; Erfahrung mit USV-Anlagen (unterbrechungsfreie Stromversorgung) ist von Vorteil
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in elektromechanischen Systemen, Diagnosetools und Serviceprozessen im industriellen Umfeld
  • Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung, Flexibilität bei wechselnden • Anforderungen sowie eine lösungsorientierte und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse und grundlegende Englischkenntnisse für die professionelle Kommunikation mit Kunden
  • Reisebereitschaft, Bereitschaft zur Teilnahme am Pikettdienst sowie zu gelegentlichen Wochenendeinsätzen; primäres Servicegebiet: Region Zentralschweiz
  • Gültiger Führerausweis für Einsätze innerhalb der Schweiz


Benefits


• We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

  • Attractive compensation package including bonus, 13th-month salary, and Employee Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)
  • Training, development, and career growth opportunities
  • Company vehicle and attractive fleet discounts
  • Contributions toward gym memberships and medical services (IFA)
  • REKA vouchers and discounts through Swibeco

More about us


ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing facilities, critical infrastructure, and commercial buildings. The division's technical teams work closely with industry partners to develop innovative solutions that support growth, the energy transition, and sustainability goals.

Its portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting solutions, and safety devices such as switches and relays. The Power Protection business supports the world's largest data center companies with advanced and energy-efficient UPS solutions. In addition, ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable and user-friendly platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO₂ emissions.


The recruitment process is managed by Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Head of EtO, Engineering, Tools and Processes

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In the local Electrification Service business unit, we help our customers secure and extend the availability and lifetime of their electrical assets. Our focus is on service solutions for low- and medium-voltage switchgear, emergency power systems, and digital solutions. We combine technical expertise, a strong service mindset, and close collaboration with our customers.


As a Service Sales Support Specialist, you will apply your technical knowledge to develop customer quotations and service solutions. Ideally, you bring practical experience with switchgear or power distribution systems. You will analyze customer requests, clarify technical requirements, and define suitable service solutions. In doing so, you ensure that proposals are technically feasible, commercially competitive, and clearly structured. You will work closely with Service Sales, Project Management, Engineering, and Field Service teams while contributing to the continuous improvement of our quotation process.


The work model for this role is: #hybrid


Your • Responsibilities

  • Analyze customer inquiries and quotation requests for service, retrofit, and modernization solutions related to electrical switchgear.
  • Define the scope of work, main components, and service deliverables based on technical requirements and practical feasibility.
  • Assess technical feasibility and solution availability in close collaboration with Engineering, Project Management, and Field Service teams.
  • Prepare cost calculations and technical sales documentation to support competitive and risk-conscious customer proposals.

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Technical education in electrical engineering or equivalent hands-on experience in a technical environment; further education at technician (TS/HF), university of applied sciences (FH), or university level is an advantage.
  • Practical experience with low-voltage or medium-voltage switchgear, for example in assembly, commissioning, service, engineering, retrofit, or project execution, is highly valued.
  • Strong technical understanding of electrical power distribution, switchgear components, and customer-focused service solutions.
  • Interest in techno-commercial topics and the ability to translate technical requirements into clear and economically sound customer proposals.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; experience with cost calculations, quotation processes, or costing models is beneficial.
  • Independent, structured, team-oriented, and customer-focused working style, with good German and English communication skills or French and English communication skills.

Benefits

• We offer an attractive overall package with a range of additional benefits:

  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credits
  • Exclusive employee discounts through MyDiscounts and Swibeco
  • Generous parental leave
  • Contribution towards fitness and well-being activities
  • Eco bonus for sustainable mobility

More About Us

The ABB Service Division partners with customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability, and sustainability of electrical products and systems. The division’s comprehensive service portfolio includes maintenance, modernization, and consulting services designed to enhance performance, extend equipment lifetime, and achieve new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help our customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, extract maximum value from them, and recover and regenerate products and materials at the end of their life cycle.


The recruitment process is being led by Talent Partner Ece Özen, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

You will work closely with Service Sales, Project Management, Engineering, and Field Service teams while contributing to the continuous improvement of our quotation process.


The work model for this role is: #hybrid


Your • Responsibilities

  • Assess technical feasibility and solution availability in close collaboration with Engineering, Project Management, and Field Service teams.
  • Prepare cost calculations and technical sales documentation to support competitive and risk-conscious customer proposals.

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Technical education in electrical engineering or equivalent hands-on experience in a technical environment; further education at technician (TS/HF), university of applied sciences (FH), or university level is an advantage.
  • Practical experience with low-voltage or medium-voltage switchgear, for example in assembly, commissioning, service, engineering, retrofit, or project execution, is highly valued.
  • Strong technical understanding of electrical power distribution, switchgear components, and customer-focused service solutions.
  • Interest in techno-commercial topics and the ability to translate technical requirements into clear and economically sound customer proposals.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; experience with cost calculations, quotation processes, or costing models is beneficial.
  • Independent, structured, team-oriented, and customer-focused working style, with good German and English communication skills or French and English communication skills.

Benefits

• We offer an attractive overall package with a range of additional benefits:

  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credits
  • Exclusive employee discounts through MyDiscounts and Swibeco
  • Generous parental leave
  • Contribution towards fitness and well-being activities
  • Eco bonus for sustainable mobility

More About Us

The ABB Service Division partners with customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability, and sustainability of electrical products and systems. The division’s comprehensive service portfolio includes maintenance, modernization, and consulting services designed to enhance performance, extend equipment lifetime, and achieve new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help our customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, extract maximum value from them, and recover and regenerate products and materials at the end of their life cycle.


The recruitment process is being led by Talent Partner Ece Özen, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will support the implementation of the local quality strategy, driving a strong quality culture, continuous improvement, and sustainable problem-solving. As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will ensure that all purchased materials and services meet ABB standards by qualifying suppliers, monitoring performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve world-class results.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Buildings / Supplier Business Excellence & Development in Schaffhausen.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Supplier Qualification & Audits: Qualify and approve new suppliers and conduct regular process, system, and product audits.
  • Quality • Requirements & FAI: Define and communicate quality requirements and lead First Article Inspections and qualification processes.
  • Performance Monitoring & Improvement: Track supplier performance using KPIs (e.g., PPM, OTD) and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Non-Conformance Management: Investigate quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and ensure effective corrective actions (8D/CAPA).


• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field) or equivalent professional experience
  • Good knowledge of English and German (spoken and written); additional languages are a plus
  • Experience in supplier quality management and supplier audits (ISO 9001, VDA 6.3, IATF 16949 or similar)
  • Knowledge of APQP/PPAP and First Article Inspection (FAI)
  • Strong problem-solving skills using root cause analysis methods (8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa)
  • Understanding of statistical quality methods (SPC, MSA, Gauge R&R)
  • Knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T, and material/component specifications


Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credit
  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Fitness allowance


More about us
ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruitment process is led by talent partner, Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

• Requisiti per il ruolo

  • Conoscenza dei metodi statistici per la qualità (SPC, MSA, Gauge R&R)
  • Conoscenza dei disegni tecnici, del GD&T e delle specifiche di materiali/componenti


Vantaggi
Offriamo inoltre ai nostri dipendenti i seguenti vantaggi:

  • Sconti per i dipendenti (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

  • Contributo per il fitness

Le tecnologie altamente innovative e le soluzioni digitali della Divisione rispondono alla crescente domanda globale da parte di sviluppatori, proprietari e investitori immobiliari di tecnologie per edifici intelligenti che ottimizzino la distribuzione dell'energia e l'automazione degli edifici. Le soluzioni scalabili mirano a offrire significativi vantaggi in termini di sostenibilità e finanziari, soddisfacendo le esigenze sociali e ambientali e riuscendo al contempo ad affrontare anche le strategie di riduzione delle emissioni di carbonio più complesse dei clienti.

jobs.title: Senior Lead Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as the technical lead for all engineering activities in assignments. Each day, you will ensure that the activities related to engineering disciplines within the project are executed in an efficient and cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by providing technical support to commissioning and start-up activities.

The work model for the role is: hybrid.

This role is contributing to the Mining & Materials Plant Automation within Process Industries in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:
  • Acting as design authority for engineering deliverables and technical solutions towards internal organisation, customers and authorities.
  • Working closely with customers to shape and deliver solutions, actively seeking feedback, to drive and deliver improvements.
  • Assisting project managers in scope control risk and opportunity assessments, implementing improvements and mitigation actions.
  • Leading, supervising, and coordinating all engineering disciplines (both in-house and outsourced) on projects of high/medium complexity.
  • Collaborating on project installation, commissioning, and site activities, to clarify potential issues or provide solutions to rectify the engineering errors.
  • Providing technical details, cost calculations and deliverables definition for sales proposals.

Our team dynamics
You will join a high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role
  • You are highly skilled in large-scale process automation DCS as ABB 800xA or comparable and the relevant market
  • Ability to demonstrate 8-10 years of experience in engineering and commissioning in large scale process automation projects with at least 2 years in lead engineer role of teams of 5-10 engineers covering software and electrical engineering.
  • Possess an enhanced knowledge of IEC 61850, TCP/IP networks, fieldbus protocols like Profibus/Net, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC, combined with good understanding and ability to apply cybersecurity practices in accordance with the IEC 62443 standard framework.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to cooperate, negotiate, and reach agreement with customers and suppliers. In addition to that, a collaborative, solution-oriented approach with strong written and spoken communication skills are essential.
  • Experience in power and energy management systems, related SW and HW design as well as related engineering practices, codes and standards.
  • Bachelor's or master's in electrical engineering, industrial automation or related technical field.
  • You are at ease communicating in English.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a operare in modo più snello e pulito—e ogni persona qui contribuisce a renderlo possibile. Avrai gli strumenti per guidare, il supporto per crescere e potrai essere orgoglioso/a dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e contribuisci a far funzionare ciò che fa funzionare il mondo.

Questa posizione riporta a:
Responsabile dell'ingegneria

__
Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità

In questo ruolo, avrai l'opportunità di fungere da responsabile tecnico per tutte le attività di ingegneria negli incarichi. Ogni giorno, garantirai che le attività relative alle discipline ingegneristiche nell'ambito del progetto siano eseguite in modo efficiente ed economicamente vantaggioso. Dimostrerai inoltre la tua competenza fornendo supporto tecnico alle attività di messa in servizio e avviamento.

Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: ibrido.

Questo ruolo contribuisce all'automazione degli impianti per il settore Mining & Materials nell'ambito di Process Industries in Svizzera.

Sarai principalmente responsabile di:
- Agire in qualità di responsabile della progettazione per i deliverable di ingegneria e le soluzioni tecniche nei confronti dell'organizzazione interna, dei clienti e delle autorità.

- Lavorare a stretto contatto con i clienti per sviluppare e fornire soluzioni, cercando attivamente feedback al fine di promuovere e realizzare miglioramenti.

- Assistere i project manager nel controllo dell'ambito e nelle valutazioni di rischi e opportunità, implementando miglioramenti e azioni di mitigazione.

- Guidare, supervisionare e coordinare tutte le discipline di ingegneria (sia interne sia esternalizzate) su progetti di elevata/media complessità.

- Collaborando all'installazione del progetto, alla messa in servizio e alle attività in sito, per chiarire i potenziali problemi o fornire soluzioni per correggere gli errori di progettazione.

- Fornendo dettagli tecnici, calcoli dei costi e definizione dei deliverable per le proposte commerciali.

Le dinamiche del nostro team
Entrerai a far parte di un team altamente performante, in cui potrai dare il meglio di te.

• Requisiti per il ruolo
- Hai competenze avanzate nell'automazione dei processi su larga scala, con DCS come ABB 800xA o sistemi comparabili, e nel relativo mercato

- Capacità di dimostrare 8-10 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria e nella messa in servizio di progetti di automazione dei processi su larga scala, con almeno 2 anni nel ruolo di lead engineer alla guida di team composti da 5-10 ingegneri, che si occupano di ingegneria del software ed elettrica.

- Possiedi una conoscenza approfondita di IEC 61850, delle reti TCP/IP e di protocolli fieldbus come Profibus/Net, Modbus TCP/RTU e OPC, combinata con una buona comprensione e capacità di applicare pratiche di cybersicurezza in conformità con il quadro dello standard IEC 62443.

- Spiccate capacità interpersonali per collaborare, negoziare e raggiungere un accordo con clienti e fornitori. Inoltre, sono essenziali un approccio collaborativo e orientato alle soluzioni, nonché solide capacità di comunicazione scritta e orale.

- Esperienza nei sistemi di gestione della potenza e dell'energia, nella progettazione del relativo SW e HW, nonché nelle relative pratiche ingegneristiche, nei codici e negli standard.

- Laurea triennale o magistrale in ingegneria elettrica, automazione industriale o campo tecnico correlato.

- Sei a tuo agio nel comunicare in inglese.

Per costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente servono menti di ogni tipo: curiose, coraggiose e creative. Ecco perché accogliamo persone di ogni provenienza e con esperienze diverse.

Pronto a fare la differenza?

Candidati oggi oppure visita https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

- Expérience des systèmes de gestion de la puissance et de l'énergie, de la conception connexe de SW et HW, ainsi que des pratiques, codes et normes d'ingénierie connexes.

- Licence ou master en génie électrique, en automatisation industrielle ou dans un domaine technique connexe.

- Vous êtes à l'aise pour communiquer en anglais.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent nécessite toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des personnes de tous horizons et de toutes expériences.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Teamleader OEE Improvement

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will specify, brief, and oversee Power Platform and MES-related solutions that remove friction from our production organization's daily operations — from digital shift handover to fault logging on the line. Each day, you will work directly with production managers, process and quality engineers to turn business needs into clear specifications, build mockups and PoCs yourself to validate feasibility, and ensure the solutions delivered by external partners meet requirements. You will also showcase your expertise by assessing proposed solutions from external service providers and owning the interface between production and vendor.

The work model for the role is: most of the time onsite/ hybrid upon current taks possible.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Gathering requirements from production managers, process and quality engineers and translating them into robust, actionable specifications.
  • Building mockups and PoCs to validate feasibility and brief external service providers before solutions are built.
  • Specifying requirements to external service providers, obtaining and assessing their proposals, and approving the resulting solution design.
  • Overseeing implementation by external partners, validating delivered solutions against requirements, and supporting rollout and user training in production.

Our team dynamics
You will join a talented, high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

Your main tasks

  • Develop and maintain Microsoft Power Platform solutions (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse) to digitalize and optimize manufacturing processes and support daily production operations.
  • Integrate and connect SQL databases, REST APIs, and machine data while ensuring compliance with IT standards and leveraging gateways and connectors.
  • Gather and analyze requirements from production stakeholders, translate them into practical solution designs, and manage implementation, user training, and continuous improvement.
  • Support the deployment of shopfloor and MES solutions, collaborate with external partners, and progressively take ownership of vendor management and the interface between production and solution providers



• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed education as a Higher Diploma (HF) in Computer Science (Application Development), a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent hands-on professional experience.
  • At least 2 years of practical experience with Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate, demonstrated through solutions you have independently developed, deployed, and supported.
  • Programming skills in C#, JavaScript, or Python, with a solid understanding of application architecture, REST APIs, integrations, and data modeling.
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Azure; certifications such as PL-200, PL-400, or AZ-204 are considered an advantage.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a operare in modo più snello e pulito—e ogni persona qui contribuisce a renderlo possibile. Ti verranno dati gli strumenti per guidare, riceverai supporto per crescere e proverai orgoglio per l'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e contribuisci a far funzionare ciò che fa funzionare il mondo.

Questa posizione riporta a:
Responsabile del miglioramento OEE

__

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità

In questo ruolo, definirai, illustrerai e supervisionerai soluzioni relative a Power Platform e MES che semplificano le operazioni quotidiane della nostra organizzazione produttiva — dal passaggio di consegne digitale tra i turni alla registrazione dei guasti sulla linea. Ogni giorno lavorerai direttamente con responsabili di produzione, ingegneri di processo e della qualità per trasformare le esigenze aziendali in specifiche chiare, creerai personalmente mockup e PoC per convalidare la fattibilità e ti assicurerai che le soluzioni fornite dai partner esterni soddisfino i requisiti. Dimostrerai inoltre la tua competenza valutando le soluzioni proposte dai fornitori di servizi esterni e gestendo l'interfaccia tra la produzione e il fornitore.

Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: per la maggior parte del tempo in sede/ibrido, quando possibile in base alle attività correnti.

Sarai principalmente responsabile di:

- Raccogliere i requisiti dai responsabili di produzione, dagli ingegneri di processo e della qualità e tradurli in specifiche solide e attuabili.

- Creare mockup e PoC per convalidare la fattibilità e fornire indicazioni ai fornitori di servizi esterni prima della realizzazione delle soluzioni.

- Definire i requisiti per i fornitori di servizi esterni, ottenere e valutare le loro proposte e approvare il progetto della soluzione risultante.

- Supervisionare l'implementazione da parte dei partner esterni, verificare che le soluzioni fornite siano conformi ai requisiti e supportare l'introduzione e la formazione degli utenti in produzione.

Le dinamiche del nostro team
Entrerai a far parte di un team competente e altamente performante, dove potrai esprimere al meglio il tuo potenziale.

Le tue attività principali

- Sviluppare e mantenere soluzioni Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse) per digitalizzare e ottimizzare i processi produttivi e supportare le operazioni quotidiane di produzione.

- Integrare e connettere database SQL, API REST e dati delle macchine, garantendo al contempo la conformità agli standard IT e sfruttando gateway e connettori.

- Raccogliere e analizzare i requisiti degli stakeholder della produzione, tradurli in progetti di soluzione concreti e gestire l'implementazione, la formazione degli utenti e il miglioramento continuo.

- Supportare l'implementazione di soluzioni per l'area produttiva e MES, collaborare con partner esterni e assumere progressivamente la responsabilità della gestione dei fornitori e dell'interfaccia tra la produzione e i fornitori di soluzioni

• Requisiti per il ruolo

- Formazione completata con un diploma superiore (HF) in Informatica (Sviluppo di applicazioni), una laurea di primo livello in Informatica o un'esperienza professionale pratica equivalente.

- Almeno 2 anni di esperienza pratica con Microsoft Power Apps e Power Automate, dimostrata attraverso soluzioni che hai sviluppato, distribuito e supportato autonomamente.

- Competenze di programmazione in C#, JavaScript o Python, con una solida conoscenza dell'architettura delle applicazioni, delle API REST, delle integrazioni e della modellazione dei dati.

- Conoscenza di base di Microsoft Azure; certificazioni come PL-200, PL-400 o AZ-204 sono considerate un vantaggio.

- Padronanza del tedesco e buona conoscenza dell'inglese, poiché collaborerai con team e stakeholder internazionali.

- Forte interesse per gli ambienti manifatturieri e produttivi; ti piace lavorare direttamente con i team di produzione e i processi produttivi, non solo da una scrivania.

Maggiori informazioni su di noi (Obbligatorio)

ABB Smart Buildings sta trasformando gli edifici commerciali, industriali e residenziali attraverso la digitalizzazione, offrendo maggiore comfort, efficienza, sicurezza e protezione. Con soluzioni, servizi e prodotti di elettrificazione sicuri, intelligenti e sostenibili, contribuiamo a migliorare la qualità della vita negli edifici del futuro.

Attendiamo con piacere la tua candidatura! Il processo di selezione è gestito da Reto Korstick, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente richiede menti di ogni tipo: curiose, coraggiose e creative. Ecco perché accogliamo con favore persone di ogni provenienza e con esperienze diverse.

Pronto a fare la differenza?

Candidati oggi stesso o visita https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien dabei, schlanker und sauberer zu arbeiten – und jede Person hier trägt dazu bei. Du erhältst den nötigen Handlungsspielraum, um Verantwortung zu übernehmen, wirst bei deiner Entwicklung unterstützt und kannst stolz auf die Wirkung sein, die wir gemeinsam erzielen. Komm zu uns und hilf dabei, das zu betreiben, was die Welt am Laufen hält.

Diese Position berichtet an:
Teamleiter OEE-Verbesserung

__

Deine Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

In dieser Rolle wirst du Lösungen im Zusammenhang mit der Power Platform und MES spezifizieren, Briefings erstellen und beaufsichtigen, die den täglichen Betrieb unserer Produktionsorganisation reibungsloser machen – von der digitalen Schichtübergabe bis zur Störungserfassung an der Linie. Jeden Tag arbeitest du direkt mit Produktionsleitern sowie Prozess- und Qualitätsingenieuren zusammen, um Geschäftsanforderungen in klare Spezifikationen zu überführen, selbst Mock-ups und PoCs zu erstellen, um die Machbarkeit zu validieren, und sicherzustellen, dass die von externen Partnern gelieferten Lösungen den Anforderungen entsprechen. Außerdem stellst du deine Expertise unter Beweis, indem du von externen Dienstleistern vorgeschlagene Lösungen bewertest und die Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion und Lieferant verantwortest.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Position ist: größtenteils vor Ort/hybrid, sofern dies aufgrund der aktuellen Aufgaben möglich ist.

Du bist hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

- Erhebung der Anforderungen von Produktionsleitern sowie Prozess- und Qualitätsingenieuren und deren Überführung in robuste, umsetzbare Spezifikationen.

- Erstellung von Mock-ups und PoCs zur Validierung der Machbarkeit sowie Briefing externer Dienstleister, bevor Lösungen erstellt werden.

- Spezifizierung der Anforderungen an externe Dienstleister, Einholung und Bewertung ihrer Vorschläge sowie Genehmigung des daraus resultierenden Lösungsdesigns.

- Überwachung der Implementierung durch externe Partner, Validierung der gelieferten Lösungen anhand der Anforderungen sowie Unterstützung bei der Einführung und Benutzerschulung in der Produktion.

Unsere Teamdynamik
Du wirst Teil eines talentierten, leistungsstarken Teams, in dem du dich entfalten kannst.

Deine Hauptaufgaben

- Entwicklung und Pflege von Microsoft Power Platform-Lösungen (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse) zur Digitalisierung und Optimierung von Fertigungsprozessen sowie zur Unterstützung des täglichen Produktionsbetriebs.

- Integration und Anbindung von SQL-Datenbanken, REST-APIs und Maschinendaten unter Einhaltung der IT-Standards sowie Nutzung von Gateways und Konnektoren.

- Erhebung und Analyse der Anforderungen von Stakeholdern aus der Produktion, Überführung in praktische Lösungsdesigns sowie Steuerung von Implementierung, Benutzerschulung und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

- Unterstützung bei der Einführung von Shopfloor- und MES-Lösungen, Zusammenarbeit mit externen Partnern sowie schrittweise Übernahme der Verantwortung für das Lieferantenmanagement und die Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion und Lösungsanbietern

• Qualifikationen für die Position

- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung mit einem Höheren Diplom (HF) in Informatik (Anwendungsentwicklung), ein Bachelorabschluss in Informatik oder gleichwertige praktische Berufserfahrung.

- Mindestens 2 Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Power Apps und Power Automate, nachgewiesen durch Lösungen, die du eigenständig entwickelt, bereitgestellt und betreut hast.

- Programmierkenntnisse in C#, JavaScript oder Python sowie ein solides Verständnis von Anwendungsarchitektur, REST-APIs, Integrationen und Datenmodellierung.

- Grundkenntnisse in Microsoft Azure; Zertifizierungen wie PL-200, PL-400 oder AZ-204 sind von Vorteil.

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse , da Sie mit internationalen Teams und Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten werden.

- Starkes Interesse an Fertigungs- und Produktionsumgebungen; Sie arbeiten gerne direkt mit Shopfloor-Teams und Produktionsprozessen, nicht nur vom Schreibtisch aus.

Mehr über uns (Erforderlich)

ABB Smart Buildings gestaltet gewerbliche, industrielle und Wohngebäude durch Digitalisierung neu und sorgt so für mehr Komfort, Effizienz, Sicherheit und Schutz. Mit sicheren, intelligenten und nachhaltigen Elektrifizierungslösungen, Dienstleistungen und Produkten tragen wir dazu bei, die Lebensqualität in den Gebäuden der Zukunft zu verbessern.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Der Recruiting-Prozess wird von Reto Korstick, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland, geleitet.

Eine sauberere, intelligentere Zukunft zu gestalten, erfordert Menschen mit ganz unterschiedlichen Denkweisen: die Neugierigen, die Mutigen und die Kreativen. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen mit unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewirken?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Wirkung unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de manière plus efficace et plus propre — et chaque personne ici y contribue. Vous aurez les moyens de prendre les rênes, le soutien nécessaire pour évoluer et la fierté de l’impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et contribuez à faire fonctionner ce qui fait tourner le monde.

Ce poste est rattaché à :
Responsable d’équipe, amélioration de l’OEE

__

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous définirez, présenterez et superviserez des solutions liées à Power Platform et au MES qui fluidifient les opérations quotidiennes de notre organisation de production — de la passation numérique des équipes à l’enregistrement des pannes sur la ligne. Chaque jour, vous travaillerez directement avec les responsables de production ainsi qu’avec les ingénieurs procédés et qualité afin de transformer les besoins métier en spécifications claires, de concevoir vous-même des maquettes et des PoC pour valider la faisabilité, et de vous assurer que les solutions livrées par les partenaires externes répondent aux exigences. Vous démontrerez également votre expertise en évaluant les solutions proposées par les prestataires de services externes et en étant responsable de l’interface entre la production et le fournisseur.

Le mode de travail pour ce poste est le suivant : principalement sur site / hybride lorsque les tâches actuelles le permettent.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

- Recueillir les exigences auprès des responsables de production, des ingénieurs procédés et qualité, et les traduire en spécifications robustes et exploitables.

- Concevoir des maquettes et des PoC afin de valider la faisabilité et de cadrer les prestataires de services externes avant la réalisation des solutions.

- Spécifier les exigences à l’intention des prestataires de services externes, obtenir et évaluer leurs propositions, et approuver la conception de la solution qui en résulte.

- Superviser la mise en œuvre par les partenaires externes, valider les solutions livrées par rapport aux exigences, et accompagner le déploiement et la formation des utilisateurs en production.

La dynamique de notre équipe
Vous rejoindrez une équipe talentueuse et très performante, où vous pourrez vous épanouir.

Vos principales missions

- Développer et maintenir des solutions Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse) afin de numériser et d’optimiser les processus de fabrication et de soutenir les opérations quotidiennes de production.

- Intégrer et connecter des bases de données SQL, des API REST et des données issues des machines, tout en garantissant la conformité aux normes informatiques et en tirant parti des passerelles et des connecteurs.

- Recueillir et analyser les exigences des parties prenantes de la production, les traduire en conceptions de solutions concrètes, et gérer la mise en œuvre, la formation des utilisateurs et l’amélioration continue.

- Accompagner le déploiement des solutions d’atelier et MES, collaborer avec des partenaires externes et prendre progressivement en charge la gestion des fournisseurs ainsi que l’interface entre la production et les fournisseurs de solutions

• Qualifications requises pour le poste

- Formation achevée sanctionnée par un diplôme supérieur (HF) en informatique (développement d’applications), un bachelor en informatique ou une expérience professionnelle pratique équivalente.

- Au moins 2 ans d’expérience pratique avec Microsoft Power Apps et Power Automate, attestée par des solutions que vous avez développées, déployées et prises en charge de manière autonome.

- Compétences en programmation en C#, JavaScript ou Python, avec une solide compréhension de l’architecture des applications, des API REST, des intégrations et de la modélisation des données.

- Connaissances de base de Microsoft Azure ; les certifications telles que PL-200, PL-400 ou AZ-204 constituent un atout.

- Maîtrise de l’allemand et bonnes compétences en anglais, car vous collaborerez avec des équipes et des parties prenantes internationales.

- Intérêt marqué pour les environnements de fabrication et de production ; vous aimez travailler directement avec les équipes de production et les processus de production, et pas seulement depuis un bureau.

En savoir plus sur nous (obligatoire)

ABB Smart Buildings transforme les bâtiments commerciaux, industriels et résidentiels grâce à la numérisation, en offrant davantage de confort, d’efficacité, de sûreté et de sécurité. Grâce à des solutions, services et produits d’électrification sûrs, intelligents et durables, nous contribuons à améliorer la qualité de vie dans les bâtiments de demain.

Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature ! Le processus de recrutement est dirigé par Reto Korstick, partenaire en recrutement, ABB Switzerland.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent nécessite toutes sortes d’esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C’est pourquoi nous accueillons des personnes de tous horizons et ayant des expériences variées.

Prêt(e) à faire la différence ?

Postulez dès aujourd’hui ou rendez-vous sur https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l’impact de nos solutions dans le monde entier.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Maintenance Team Leader

__

At ABB, we value individual differences, both as individuals and as a team.

ABB Switzerland Ltd., CMC Low Voltage Products, with around 270 employees, is a leading developer, manufacturer, and international supplier of low-voltage protection devices and the CMS current monitoring system. A customer-focused mindset, short decision-making paths, and a high degree of personal responsibility are key to strengthening our market position.

To strengthen our motivated team in Schaffhausen, we are looking for an engaged Service Technician to join us as soon as possible. Do you enjoy solving technical problems and helping to ensure smooth operations in a stable, growing, and modern manufacturing environment?


We look forward to receiving your application.


Your role and responsibilities


• Troubleshoot and resolve issues on highly automated production equipment (mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic)

• Perform preventive maintenance and servicing of production equipment

• Collaborate closely with manufacturing teams, Production Engineering, and external service providers to ensure smooth production operations

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the production environment, including Lean Management activities


• Qualifications for the role


• Completed vocational training as an Automation Technician, Mechatronics Technician, Mechanical Technician, Production Technician, Electrician, or in a comparable technical field

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in industrial automation, ideally within a manufacturing environment

• Experience troubleshooting and repairing complex production and assembly systems (mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic)

• NIV13 or NIV15 electrical installation certification is an advantage, or willingness to obtain it with ABB support

• Strong teamwork and communication skills, combined with a proactive and independent working style

• Basic knowledge of MS Office and SAP, as well as excellent German language skills (written and spoken); English language skills are an advantage

• Willingness to work in a three-shift operation, including on-call duty after the onboarding period


Benefits


• We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

• Attractive compensation package including bonus, 13th-month salary, and Employee Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)

• Training, development, and career growth opportunities

• Contributions toward gym memberships and medical services (IFA)

• REKA vouchers and discounts through Swibeco

• 27 to 30 days of annual leave, plus paid company holidays between Christmas and New Year


More about us


Our Schaffhausen site has been growing steadily for many years.

Our diverse production environment offers exciting and varied areas of responsibility, ranging from proven, long-established technologies to state-of-the-art system solutions. Our machine park is continuously expanding with new equipment that is aligned with industry benchmarks.

ABB Smart Buildings digitizes commercial, industrial, and residential buildings to deliver the highest levels of comfort, efficiency, safety, and security. Through safe, intelligent, and sustainable electrification solutions, services, and products, we are improving quality of life in the buildings of the future.


The recruitment process is managed by Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues on highly automated production equipment (mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic)

Bei ABB schätzen wir individuelle Unterschiede, sowohl als Individuen als auch als Team.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead a regional service team with diverse expertise in service planning, order processing, and service execution within the Electrification business area. Together with your team, you will ensure comprehensive customer support for Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems across the German-speaking region of Switzerland.


Reporting directly to the Head of Service UPS Systems, you will make a significant contribution to the implementation of the service strategy and the promotion of business growth. Through efficient planning and targeted allocation of resources, while ensuring compliance with established processes, procedures, and guidelines, you will drive high service quality and operational excellence.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Leading, coaching, and developing a regional service team consisting of Service Coordinators, Order Handling Specialists, Technical Support Engineers, and Field Service Technicians, while fostering a motivating, safe, and performance-oriented work environment.
  • Taking overall responsibility for all service activities, customer orders, and maintenance operations within the region, ensuring the achievement of quality, performance, and commercial targets, maintaining customer relationships, and delivering high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Providing operational support to the team (approximately 60% of the role) in service planning (FSL), including the review and approval of weekly reports and expense claims.
  • Ensuring the implementation of and compliance with all occupational health and safety requirements.


Your • Qualifications

  • Technical vocational training in Electrical Engineering, complemented by a job-related advanced qualification at Higher Technical College level (e.g., Certified Technician, Master Craftsman, or equivalent).
  • Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience in the maintenance, servicing, commissioning, and repair of electrical installations.
  • Experience with power electronics and/or UPS systems.
  • Several years of leadership experience in a similar position.
  • A flexible and resilient personality with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • A structured and solution-oriented approach to work and problem-solving.
  • Willingness to travel throughout Switzerland.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications as well as SAP or other ERP systems.
  • Excellent German and English language skills, both written and spoken; French and Italian are an advantage.


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:


  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credits
  • Exclusive employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Contribution towards fitness and health programs
  • Eco Bonus (sustainability incentive)


More About Us

ABB’s Service Division partners with customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability, and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The division’s comprehensive service portfolio includes product care, modernization, and consulting services designed to enhance performance, extend equipment lifetime, and achieve new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help our customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, maximize the value derived from them, and recover and regenerate products and materials at the end of their lifecycle.


This recruitment process is being managed by Talent Partner Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Responsabile del servizio

__

Il tuo ruolo e • Responsabilità

In questo ruolo, guiderai un team di assistenza regionale con competenze diversificate nella pianificazione dei servizi, nell'elaborazione degli ordini e nell'esecuzione dei servizi all'interno dell'area aziendale Elettrificazione. Insieme al tuo team, garantirai un'assistenza clienti completa per i sistemi di continuità (UPS) nella regione di lingua tedesca della Svizzera.


Riportando direttamente al responsabile del servizio UPS Systems, fornirai un contributo significativo all'implementazione della strategia di servizio e alla promozione della crescita aziendale. Attraverso una pianificazione efficiente e un'allocazione mirata delle risorse, garantendo al contempo la conformità con processi, procedure e linee guida stabiliti, promuoverai un'elevata qualità del servizio e l'eccellenza operativa.


Sarai principalmente responsabile di:

  • Dirigere, istruire e sviluppare un team di assistenza regionale composto da coordinatori di servizio, specialisti nella gestione degli ordini e supporto tecnico Ingegneri e tecnici dell'assistenza sul campo, promuovendo al contempo un ambiente di lavoro motivante, sicuro e orientato alle prestazioni.
  • Assumersi la responsabilità generale di tutte le attività di assistenza, ordini dei clienti e operazioni di manutenzione all'interno della regione, garantendo il raggiungimento di obiettivi di qualità, prestazioni e commerciali, mantenendo le relazioni con i clienti e offrendo elevati livelli di soddisfazione del cliente.
  • Fornire supporto operativo al team (circa il 60% del ruolo) nella pianificazione dei servizi (FSL), inclusa la revisione e l'approvazione delle relazioni settimanali e delle note spese.
  • Garantire l'implementazione e il rispetto di tutti i requisiti di salute e sicurezza sul lavoro.


Il tuo • Qualifiche

  • Formazione tecnica professionale in ingegneria elettrica, integrata da una qualifica avanzata correlata al lavoro a livello di istituto tecnico superiore (ad esempio, tecnico certificato, maestro artigiano o equivalente).
  • forte conoscenza tecnica ed esperienza pratica nella manutenzione, assistenza, messa in servizio e riparazione di installazioni elettriche.
  • Esperienza con elettronica di potenza e/o sistemi UPS.
  • Diversi anni di esperienza di leadership in una posizione simile.
  • Una personalità flessibile e resiliente con forti capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione.
  • Un approccio strutturato e orientato alla soluzione al lavoro e alla risoluzione dei problemi.
  • Disponibilità a viaggiare in tutta la Svizzera.
  • Competenza nelle applicazioni Microsoft Office e SAP o altri sistemi ERP.
  • Ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca e inglese, sia scritta che parlata; Il francese e l'italiano sono un vantaggio.


Vantaggi

Offriamo inoltre ai nostri dipendenti i seguenti vantaggi:


  • Piano di acquisizione di azioni per i dipendenti (ESAP)
  • Crediti REKA
  • Sconti esclusivi per i dipendenti (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Congedo parentale
  • Contributo per programmi di fitness e salute
  • Eco Bonus (incentivo alla sostenibilità)


Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Partner della Divisione Servizi di ABB con i clienti per migliorare la disponibilità, l’affidabilità, la prevedibilità e la sostenibilità dei prodotti e delle installazioni elettriche. Il portafoglio completo di servizi della divisione comprende cura del prodotto, modernizzazione e servizi di consulenza progettati per migliorare le prestazioni, prolungare la durata delle apparecchiature e raggiungere nuovi livelli di efficienza operativa e sostenibile. Aiutiamo i nostri clienti a mantenere le risorse in uso il più a lungo possibile, a massimizzare il valore che ne deriva e a recuperare e rigenerare prodotti e materiali alla fine del loro ciclo di vita.


Questo processo di reclutamento è gestito dal Talent Partner Ece Özen.

Per costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente sono necessarie menti di tutti i tipi: curiose, coraggiose e creative. Ecco perché diamo il benvenuto a persone di ogni provenienza ed esperienza.

Pronto a lasciare il segno?

Fai domanda oggi o visita https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Department Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a Research Scientist, you will be working on sensing solutions for ABB’s next generation systems and products. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contributing to and leading research projects in the field of sensors and industrial sensing applications addressing the needs of our businesses, with applications including automation, process industries, and electrification.
  • Together with multidisciplinary project teams, develop novel, high-value sensing products and solutions from the concept definition phase to the experimental verification.
  • Evaluate new technologies and conduct technical surveys, generate project proposals with business impact and collaborate with researchers and engineers from other research centers, ABB business units, as well as from universities.
  • Disseminate your results with scientific publications and internal technical reports, generate intellectual property.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD university degree in electrical engineering, computer science, or related field
  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in signal processing and data analytics (including ML/deep-learning-based) e.g. denoising, feature extraction, time-series analysis and anomaly detection, signal classification and pattern recognition
  • Hands-on experience with test, design, simulation and validation of electronic systems, embedded electronics, (wireless-) connectivity, testing methodologies and data-driven validation, edge/embedded ML deployment
  • Solid experience of getting ideas from concepts to prototypes
  • Strong interest in sensing technologies and integration of sensors in systems. Context knowledge in electrification-related applications considered as a plus
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages (C/C++, Python, Matlab and modern ML frameworks -PyTorch-), and use of coding agents
  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude and excellent command (written & oral) of the English language

More about us

The ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil, Switzerland, is where we investigate new technologies which support and drive the development of ABB’s next-generation products and solutions. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application, including CV, cover letter and list of publications. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com. This position is managed by Pedro Labian (Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland).

ABB Data Privacy Statement: https://new.abb.com/privacy-notice/candidate

Take the next step in your ABB journey and apply today.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

In ABB , aiutiamo le industrie a operare in modo più efficiente e pulito—e ogni persona qui rende tutto questo possibile. Avrai l'opportunità di guidare, il sostegno per crescere e l'orgoglio per l'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e contribuisci a far funzionare ciò che fa funzionare il mondo.

Questa posizione riporta a:
Responsabile del dipartimento di ricerca

__

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità

In qualità di ricercatore scientifico, lavorerai a soluzioni di rilevamento per i sistemi e i prodotti di prossima generazione di ABB. Cerchiamo un membro del team con una comprovata esperienza nel campo della ricerca e il desiderio di trasferire e applicare la ricerca accademica di livello mondiale in un ambiente industriale. Lavorerai all'interno del team internazionale e altamente motivato di scienziati di ABB Research.
• Offriamo un ambiente di lavoro aperto e innovativo, con numerose e diversificate opportunità per far crescere la tua carriera.

Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: #LI-hybrid

Sarai principalmente responsabile di:

- Contribuire a progetti di ricerca e guidarli nel campo dei sensori e delle applicazioni di rilevamento industriale che rispondono alle esigenze delle nostre attività, con applicazioni che includono l'automazione, le industrie di processo e l'elettrificazione.

- Insieme a team di progetto multidisciplinari, sviluppare prodotti e soluzioni innovativi e ad alto valore aggiunto per il rilevamento, dalla fase di definizione del concetto fino alla verifica sperimentale.

- Valutare nuove tecnologie e condurre indagini tecniche, elaborare proposte progettuali con impatto aziendale e collaborare con ricercatori e ingegneri di altri centri di ricerca, delle unità aziendali di ABB e delle università.

- Diffondere i tuoi risultati attraverso pubblicazioni scientifiche e relazioni tecniche interne, generare proprietà intellettuale.

• Requisiti per il ruolo

- Dottorato di ricerca in ingegneria elettrica, informatica o un campo correlato

- Conoscenza teorica e pratica dell'elaborazione dei segnali e dell'analisi dei dati (incluse le tecniche basate su ML/deep learning), ad es. riduzione del rumore, estrazione delle caratteristiche, analisi delle serie temporali e rilevamento delle anomalie, classificazione dei segnali e riconoscimento dei modelli

- Esperienza pratica nel collaudo, nella progettazione, nella simulazione e nella validazione di sistemi elettronici, nell'elettronica embedded, nella connettività (wireless), nelle metodologie di test e nella validazione basata sui dati, nonché nell'implementazione di ML su dispositivi edge/embedded

- Solida esperienza nel portare le idee dalla fase concettuale ai prototipi

- Forte interesse per le tecnologie di rilevamento e per l'integrazione dei sensori nei sistemi. La conoscenza del contesto applicativo relativo all'elettrificazione è considerata un vantaggio

- Padronanza di uno o più linguaggi di programmazione (C/C++, Python, Matlab e framework ML moderni -PyTorch-) e utilizzo di agenti di programmazione

- Eccellenti capacità comunicative, attitudine al lavoro di squadra e ottima padronanza della lingua inglese (scritta e parlata)

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

L'ABB Research Center, situato a Baden-Dättwil, in Svizzera, è il luogo in cui studiamo nuove tecnologie che supportano e guidano lo sviluppo dei prodotti e delle soluzioni di prossima generazione di ABB. I nostri team internazionali di ricerca si concentrano sull'elettronica di potenza, sull'accumulo di energia, sui sistemi intelligenti e sulla commutazione.

Attendiamo di ricevere la tua candidatura, inclusi CV, lettera di presentazione ed elenco delle pubblicazioni. Se desideri saperne di più su ABB, dai un'altra occhiata al nostro sito web www.abb.com . Questa posizione è gestita da Pedro Labian (Partner per l'acquisizione dei talenti presso ABB Switzerland).

Informativa sulla privacy dei dati di ABB: https://new.abb.com/privacy-notice/candidate

Pronto per la tua prossima sfida?

Fai il prossimo passo nel tuo percorso in ABB e candidati oggi stesso.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente richiede menti di ogni tipo: curiose, coraggiose e creative. Ecco perché accogliamo persone di ogni provenienza e con esperienze diverse.

Pronto a fare la differenza?

Candidati oggi stesso o visita https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.
